title: Add option to display timezone codes in map view comboboxes
line: The time zone picker now shows each zone's code next to the city, like "Tokyo (JST)" or "Los Angeles (PST)".
explanation: The map time zone picker (used by the Date & Time settings, the Digital Clock's "Add Time Zone" page and plasma-setup) listed only region and city names in its comboboxes, so someone who knows a zone as PST, JST or CET had to guess which city it belongs to. The old searchable list that the clock settings had before the map view is gone, so codes could not be found anywhere when picking a zone. TimeZoneUtils gains an abbreviation() helper (QTimeZone::abbreviation at the current time), and the Time zone combobox entries, desktop and mobile, now read "City (CODE)" while the selection still uses the city id.

commits.message:
components/timezoneselector: show time zone abbreviations in the list

The time zone combobox only listed city names, so people who know a zone
by its code (PST, JST, CET…) had to guess which city it belongs to. Each
entry now also shows the zone's current abbreviation, like "Tokyo (JST)".

BUG: 440881

media.caption: Date & Time settings, Europe: the Time zone list shows only city names
Same list with the fix: Amsterdam (CET), Athens (EET), Dublin (GMT)…
Digital Clock settings > Time Zones > Add Time Zone, region America: city names only
Same page with the fix: Adak (HST), Anchorage (AKST), Atikokan (EST)…

reviews.text: Displaying the current time zone abbreviation inline as 'City (CODE)' in TimezoneSelector's desktop and mobile comboboxes cleanly satisfies the retitled request across Date & Time settings, Digital Clock settings, and plasma-setup without adding unnecessary configuration clutter. However, calling locationsOf(prefix) unconditionally in both desktop and mobile onSelectedTimeZoneChanged handlers rebuilds the full region array on every timezone selection—even within the same region—which constructs hundreds of QTimeZone instances (reading tzfiles from disk on Linux) and resets the ComboBox model twice per click.
changes: Memoize locationsOf(region) per region (and/or skip reassigning locationComboBox.model when the region prefix has not changed, and skip updating the inactive desktop/mobile combobox) so selecting or clicking time zones does not repeatedly construct QTimeZone objects and reset the ComboBox model.

Compute QDateTime::currentDateTime() once per batch (or pass it / build the region's abbreviations in one helper) rather than querying the clock and constructing QTimeZone objects on every single timezone change.
